title: Scrolling a long list destroys the offscreen editor and closes the keyboard
source: Monday 2026-11-09 physical shopping test reported on 2026-11-11. Major functionality worked as expected; with 40+ items, editor at index 0 and native keyboard open, scrolling to the end closes the keyboard.
scope: User explicitly requested review of the Qt 5 ListView cache solution and a Qt 6 fix. Preserve the continuous-entry design without caching every row.
reproduction: Open edit mode with 40 or more items and the editor at index 0.
Open the native keyboard, optionally type an unsubmitted draft.
Scroll far enough toward the end to move the editor beyond the delegate cache.
actual: The editor delegate is released, losing focus/draft and closing the virtual keyboard.
expected: Scrolling preserves the same editor, draft and keyboard while ordinary offscreen rows remain eligible for release. Returning to the editor permits normal Return submission and Back behavior.
legacy_review: Qt 5 qt5/qshopper:qml/View.qml uses cacheBuffer: theme.heights.large * 40; the pre-fix Qt 6 view cached 20 reference rows. Enlarging that buffer only moves the failure threshold and retains extra ordinary delegates.
qt_review: Qt ListView currentItem is retained outside the cache. Keep the movable editor current, disable highlight following and automatic key navigation, and use the user-selected 40-row cache. reuseItems is a possible later measured performance optimization, not an identity-preservation fix; pooled gesture/animation state would need a separate review.

regression.windows: tests/keyboard/tst_keyboard.qml::test_offscreen_editor_keeps_draft_focus_and_keyboard, with 40 and 200 items. Both original cases fail because scrolling dismisses the real desktop virtual keyboard. Evidence: out/ui035/keyboard-before.txt.
regression.android: Original APK fails with 40 items at scroll step 3: native IME closes. Final 40-row-cache/retained-editor APK passes 10 checks each for 40 and 200 items, both themes, real Gboard/touch, exact draft, Return, original saved identity/order/checks and Back. Existing UI-033 end-editor regression also passes eight checks. Evidence: out/ui035/android-before-final-test, android-40, android-200 and android-end-editor/results.json.
regression.windows_after: Final 40-row-cache Windows build passes all five affected CTest entries: ui 214, flow 19, fastundo 18, keyboard 9, model 104. The keyboard entry includes both new 40/200-row scenarios. Report: out/ui035/windows-tests-final.txt and verification-summary.json.
regression.packages: Final ARM64 and x86_64 Debug APKs built with the selected 40-row cache and pass actual package checks. Both are signed with the existing shared debug key. SHA-256 values: out/ui035/apk-hashes.json. No physical-phone installation performed.
regression.quality: QML formatting check, Python parse, ticket JSON and changed documentation links pass. Normal AVD data and phone untouched; the task-owned temporary emulator disk was removed after successful tests (out/ui035/emulator-cleanup.json).

cache_decision: User explicitly selected roughly one weekly family shopping list as the cache target and proposed 40 rows. Keep 40 row-heights per side of the viewport, matching the Qt 5 heuristic; do not use a larger unsupported family-size estimate. Editor lifetime is protected independently for longer lists.
implementation: Implemented 2026-11-11. ShopView caches 40 reference rows per side and binds currentIndex to Model.editorIndex. The current delegate survives beyond that cache, preserving the actual field/draft/focus/IME. Disable highlight following and automatic list key navigation so ordinary scrolling and field focus remain user controlled. Other rows still release; reuseItems stays at the existing false default.
remaining: None for UI-035. UX-007 remains open for the separate 110% sensitivity shopping trial.
phone_confirmation: User confirmed Works and requested closure/commit on 2026-11-11 after receiving the fixed ARM64 test APK. This confirmation is separate from the earlier Monday shopping report.
